title: Resource Library
description: Published the Resource Library — a curated collection of guides and resources. I also reworked the menu across the site for smoother navigation and a more consistent experience.

title: Espresso Variables Explorer and a lot of polish
description: Launched the interactive Espresso Variables Explorer. Added an in‑site Changelog. Made the guides easier to use with clear Read Online, Download and Share actions. Switched contact from Discord to email (coffee@altoeworks.net).

title: Glossary grows
description: Added more terms and a few quality‑of‑life tweaks to the interactive glossary to make browsing and filtering smoother.

title: Sharing and momentum
description: Added a subtle progress bar to every page, native share buttons to the guides, and published the first version of the interactive glossary.

title: Tip jar
description: Added a Ko‑fi link for anyone who wants to support the project. Thank you! Also restyled the title page of both guides for a cleaner, more welcoming start.

title: New guide: Under Pressure
description: Published the second long‑form guide, ‘Under Pressure’ — a deep‑dive into espresso technique, taste and chaos.

title: Smoother and faster
description: Another round of quality‑of‑life and performance improvements across the site (snappier loads, smoother interactions).

title: Quality‑of‑life pass
description: General polish and performance tweaks to make the site feel nicer to use.

title: Anatomy title page refresh
description: Restyled the title page of ‘The Anatomy of Coffee Flavor’ for clearer hierarchy and a cleaner first impression.

title: Words that sound like me
description: Overhauled the on‑site text to be friendlier, more ‘me’, and generally a lot more pleasant to read.

title: First release
description: Shipped the initial website with the first guide 'The Anatomy of Coffee Flavor'. The start of it all.
